entities.name: Dominic Mai Thanh Lương
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dominic Mai Thanh Lương was a Vietnamese-born American prelate of the Catholic Church. He was an auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Orange from 2003 to 2015. He was the first Vietnamese-born Bishop in the United States.
